text: mallikāsuttaṃ [346] sāvatthiyaṃ ... tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadikosalo mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato hoti . atha kho rājā pasenadikosalo mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavoca atthi nu kho te mallike ko cañño attanā piyataroti . natthi kho me mahārājaa ko cañño attanā piyataro tuyhaṃ pana mahārāja atthañño koci attanā piyataroti . mayhampi kho mallike natthañño koci attanā piyataroti . [347] atha kho rājā pasenadikosalo pāsādā orohitvā 1 yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadikosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca idhāhaṃ bhante mallikāya deviyā saddhiṃ uparipāsādavaragato mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavocaṃ atthi nu kho mallike #1 sī. otaritvā . ko cañño attanā piyataroti evaṃ vutte bhante mallikā devī maṃ etadavoca natthi kho me mahārāja ko cañño attanā piyataroti 1 tuyhaṃ pana mahārāja atthañño koci attanā piyataroti evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante mallikaṃ deviṃ etadavocaṃ mayhampi kho mallike natthañño koci attanā piyataroti . [348] atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi sabbā disā anuparigamma cetasā nevajjhagā piyataramattanā kvaci evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresaṃ tasmā na hiṃse paraṃ attakāmoti . navamaṃ
